data.title: Sati Store: The Mobile Cart Bringing Dhamma to City Streets
data.description: Chulalongkorn University and Suan Mokkh Bangkok introduce "Sati Store", a mobile cart blending creative design with everyday Buddhist philosophy

data.title: In their words: Israeli forces describe AI-backed Gaza killing in new film
data.description: VENICE - A new documentary from two Oscar-winning Israeli filmmakers provides damning new testimony about AI-enabled mass killings in Gaza from the men and women who took part, the directors told AFP on Thursday ahead of its premiere in Venice.

data.title: Thai artists performing in China in celebration of ties
data.description: Around 100 Thai artists and musicians have travelled to perform at the Beijing International Great Wall Concert 2026, taking place Sep 10-11 , marking 51 years of diplomatic relations between the two countries.

data.title: Yemen's Houthis seize key city on Red Sea: military source
data.description: SANAA - Yemen's Houthis seized control of the strategic Red Sea port city of Mokha on Thursday, a Yemeni military source told AFP, as the Iran-backed group reported fresh strikes by Saudi forces.

data.title: Analysts say Israel's right could exploit sanctions in run-up to vote
data.description: JERUSALEM - British-led sanctions over settlement expansion in the West Bank may have the unintended effect of emboldening the Israeli right ahead of elections, analysts and a diplomatic source told AFP.

data.title: Vance takes spotlight as Republicans close Trump-heavy convention
data.description: DALLAS (UNITED STATES) - US Republicans returned to the stage Thursday to close their midterm convention, still betting that Donald Trump's political magnetism can overcome grim election forecasts -- while giving Vice President JD Vance a prime-time showcase as a potential heir.

data.title: Siam Piwat and WFP Partner to Deliver 100,000 Meals for Food Security
data.description: Because every meal has the power to create a meaningfuldifference andimpact, Siam Piwat Group has joined hands with the United Nations World FoodProgramme(WFP) to launch “The Next Bucket: Save Lives & Change Lives”.Theinitiative invites everyone to share the power of giving through food, supporting WFP’s mission toassistpeopleand communities affected by crises and food insecurity across Asiaand thePacific.

data.title: ‘Practical Magic 2’ is more practical than magical
data.description: Practical Magic 2 (2026) marks a cinematic return to the world of witches and magic, 28 years after the original. The Owens sisters are back, not only to confront their dark family curse, but also to learn how to stop being overprotective parents and finally embrace who they are.

data.title: SCGD Targets 4.5B EBITDA and 2x EPS by 2031, Driving ASEAN Growth via Thailand-Vietnam Strengths
data.description: SCG Decor Public Company Limited (SCGD), a leader in decorativesurfaceand sanitaryware in ASEAN, is moving forward into the next phase of its growth towardsbecoming a fully integrated leader in interior products in ASEAN. This follows three years in which the company has laid a strong business foundation, including improving operational efficiency and restructuring andconsolidatingproduction for its core tile and sanitaryware businesses. The company has set a target for 2031 to raise EBITDA to 4,500 millionbahtand to grow earnings per share (EPS) by two times, through three key strategies: expansion into new product businesses, profit enhancement through production consolidation in ASEAN, and capturing growth opportunities in Vietnam, alongside positioning Vietnam as the region's production and export hub.

data.title: Merz Aesthetics Hosts “PRI’ME THE FUTURE SYMPOSIUM 2026”
data.description: Bangkok – 2 September 2026 – Merz Aesthetics, the world’s largest dedicated medical aesthetics business, hosted “PRI’ME THE FUTURE SYMPOSIUM 2026” at Dusit Thani Bangkok, a major regional Ultherapy PRIME symposium bringing together more than 370 partners, healthcare professionals and experts from across Asia-Pacific, including Thailand, South Korea, Australia, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam and India. The symposium provided a platform to exchange knowledge, clinical experience and perspectives on innovation, while exploring new directions and collectively shaping the future of the aesthetic medicine industry.

data.title: "A Culture of Light, Shadow and Flowing Stream" Art Exhibition Opens at Siam Paragon
data.description: “ACulture of Light, Shadow and Flowing Stream”is an art exhibition that celebrates the beauty of Thai culture through the integration ofphotography, painting, and sculpture. Using“light and shadow”as an artistic language, the exhibition reflects the continuous“flow” of culture, much like ariver that is never still.

data.title: More expert input sought on Bangkok data centres
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) will seek more expert input as it tries to get a clearer picture of the environmental impact and potential effects of data centres on surrounding communities in the capital.

data.title: Trump promises Americans $5,000 if Republicans win Congress
data.description: DALLAS — United States President Donald Trump on Wednesday promised US$5,000 to every American adult if Republicans retain control of Congress in November, coupling the extraordinary claim with a plea for his supporters to "pretend" he was on the ballot.

data.title: Thai Scientists Turn Dog Fat into Potential Diabetes Cure for Pets
data.description: Researchers at Chulalongkorn University transform canine fat tissue into functional insulin-producing cells, paving the way for a lasting cure for pet diabetes

data.title: Macron urges Europe to develop 'crewed spaceflight' programme
data.description: PARIS — French President Emmanuel Macron on Thursday called on Europe to develop its own crewed spaceflight capability within a decade as part of a broader push to strengthen the continent's space sector.

data.title: North Korea leader's daughter believed to have younger sibling: Seoul
data.description: SEOUL - North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's daughter and apparent successor is believed to have a younger sibling, South Korea's spy agency said on Thursday, offering a more detailed view of the ruling family's line of succession.

data.title: City-airport trains resume normal timetable
data.description: Trains on the Bangkok-Suvarnabhumi Airport Rail Link resumed their normal schedule, running every 10 minutes on Wednesday evening, after the operator said safety checks that had previously forced delays were completed.

data.title: A new thread in Thai heritage
data.description: Thailand’s textile heritage took centre stage at the Authors’ Lounge of the Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok, where 27 international delegates of Miss International Queen 2026 stepped onto the runway in contemporary interpretations of royal Thai costumes.

data.title: Wars pose a test as India hosts Brics summit
data.description: NEW DELHI - India will host leaders including the presidents of Russia and Iran for a Brics summit on Saturday, with wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, as well as economic challenges, to dominate talks among the 11-member group.

data.title: Thailand Coaching Summit to explore human roles in AI era
data.description: The Thailand Coaching Summit 2026 will bring together leading executives, organisational development professionals and coaching experts to explore the evolving role of coaching leadership, human-AI collaboration and sustainable high-performance cultures. Taking place on Nov 11 at Thammasat Association, Bangkok, the summit will be held under the theme “Building a Coaching Culture for Modern Organizations.”

data.title: Phuket protest against Jewish New Year event going ahead
data.description: PHUKET - A local civic group is going ahead with its planned demonstration on Friday against a Jewish New Year celebration, despite organisers scaling back the event amid security concerns.

data.title: Sri Lankan monk sent back to jail as pardon revoked
data.description: COLOMBO - Sri Lanka’s Supreme Court overturned Thursday a presidential pardon granted to a hardline nationalist Buddhist monk and ordered him to serve the remainder of a six-year prison sentence for intimidating the wife of a missing cartoonist.

data.title: BMW Group Thailand, Master Car Rental prep 250+ vehicles for major international conference
data.description: Bangkok. BMW Group Thailand, in partnership with Master Car Rental, operating as SIXT Thailand, announced a significant collaboration to prepare and provide a premium fleet of over 250 BMW vehicles to the Ministry of Finance. These vehicles will serve as the official mobility fleet for world leaders and delegates attending a major international conference later this year.

data.title: Nok Krasip connects small traders with AI tools and bank loans
data.description: Nok Krasip links AI sales tools with bank loans, including up to THB500,000 for small traders and a separate SME option offering up to THB3 million.

data.title: Indian trailblazer seeks Asian Games weightlifting glory
data.description: NEW DELHI - Indian weightlifter Mirabai Chanu says she “will not let go” of the chance to round off a glittering career with an elusive Asian Games medal, saying her goal feels “so close”.

data.title: Police gunman surrenders after overnight house siege
data.description: CHON BURI - The policeman who shot his teacher wife to death at a kindergarten on Wednesday has surrendered after an overnight siege at his house in Bang Lamung district.
